title: Valorant Esports
shortDescription: Follow Valorant matches, live scores, events and your favorite teams. Ad-free.
fullDescription:
Follow the Valorant scene, from the next match to the final map.

Valorant Esports, formerly VLR.gg (Unofficial), brings match schedules, live scores, event results and rankings together in one ad-free app.

YOUR MATCH DAY, AT A GLANCE
Browse live, upcoming and completed matches. Check start times in your local time zone, explore map scores and player stats, and find stream and VOD links from match details. Add upcoming matches to your calendar.

YOUR FAVORITES, TOGETHER
Favorite teams, players, matches and events to build your own Home feed. See the matches and events connected to the people and teams you follow.

FOLLOW THE WHOLE EVENT
Explore event schedules, participating teams, standings and results. Check team rosters, player profiles and regional rankings to keep up with the wider scene.

KEEP MATCHES CLOSE
Add home screen widgets for upcoming matches and favorite matches. Open a match directly from its widget and keep an eye on scores without opening the full app. Background updates depend on your device's refresh schedule.

CATCH UP ON YOUR TERMS
Hide results and stats with spoiler controls until you are ready to see them. Choose a light or dark appearance, and enjoy layouts that adapt to phones, tablets and foldables.

Free, ad-free and open source. No VLR account required.

Valorant Esports is an independent, unofficial app. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Riot Games or VLR.gg. Valorant and related marks belong to their respective owners. Match information is sourced from VLR.gg.
